185  /**

192  @Test
193  public void testBucketAllocator() throws BucketAllocatorException {
194    BucketAllocator mAllocator = cache.getAllocator();
195    /*
196     * Test the allocator first
197     */
198    final List<Integer> BLOCKSIZES = Arrays.asList(4 * 1024, 8 * 1024, 64 * 1024, 96 * 1024);
199
200    boolean full = false;
201    ArrayList<Pair<Long, Integer>> allocations = new ArrayList<>();
202    // Fill the allocated extents by choosing a random blocksize. Continues selecting blocks until
203    // the cache is completely filled.
204    List<Integer> tmp = new ArrayList<>(BLOCKSIZES);
205    while (!full) {
206      Integer blockSize = null;
207      try {
208        blockSize = randFrom(tmp);
209        allocations.add(new Pair<>(mAllocator.allocateBlock(blockSize), blockSize));
210      } catch (CacheFullException cfe) {
211        tmp.remove(blockSize);
212        if (tmp.isEmpty()) full = true;
213      }
214    }
215
216    for (Integer blockSize : BLOCKSIZES) {
217      BucketSizeInfo bucketSizeInfo = mAllocator.roundUpToBucketSizeInfo(blockSize);
218      IndexStatistics indexStatistics = bucketSizeInfo.statistics();
219      assertEquals("unexpected freeCount for " + bucketSizeInfo, 0, indexStatistics.freeCount());
220
221      // we know the block sizes above are multiples of 1024, but default bucket sizes give an
222      // additional 1024 on top of that so this counts towards fragmentation in our test
223      // real life may have worse fragmentation because blocks may not be perfectly sized to block
224      // size, given encoding/compression and large rows
225      assertEquals(1024 * indexStatistics.totalCount(), indexStatistics.fragmentationBytes());
226    }
227
228    mAllocator.logDebugStatistics();
229
230    for (Pair<Long, Integer> allocation : allocations) {
231      assertEquals(mAllocator.sizeOfAllocation(allocation.getFirst()),
232        mAllocator.freeBlock(allocation.getFirst(), allocation.getSecond()));
233    }
234    assertEquals(0, mAllocator.getUsedSize());
235  }

253  public static void waitUntilFlushedToBucket(BucketCache cache, BlockCacheKey cacheKey)
254    throws InterruptedException {
255    Waiter.waitFor(HBaseConfiguration.create(), 10000,
256      () -> (cache.backingMap.containsKey(cacheKey) && !cache.ramCache.containsKey(cacheKey)));
257  }
258
259  public static void waitUntilAllFlushedToBucket(BucketCache cache) throws InterruptedException {
260    while (!cache.ramCache.isEmpty()) {
261      Thread.sleep(100);
262    }
263    Thread.sleep(1000);
264  }
265
266  // BucketCache.cacheBlock is async, it first adds block to ramCache and writeQueue, then writer
267  // threads will flush it to the bucket and put reference entry in backingMap.
268  private void cacheAndWaitUntilFlushedToBucket(BucketCache cache, BlockCacheKey cacheKey,
269    Cacheable block, boolean waitWhenCache) throws InterruptedException {
270    cache.cacheBlock(cacheKey, block, false, waitWhenCache);
271    waitUntilFlushedToBucket(cache, cacheKey);
272  }
273
274  @Test
275  public void testMemoryLeak() throws Exception {
276    final BlockCacheKey cacheKey = new BlockCacheKey("dummy", 1L);
277    cacheAndWaitUntilFlushedToBucket(cache, cacheKey,
278      new CacheTestUtils.ByteArrayCacheable(new byte[10]), true);
279    long lockId = cache.backingMap.get(cacheKey).offset();
280    ReentrantReadWriteLock lock = cache.offsetLock.getLock(lockId);
281    lock.writeLock().lock();
282    Thread evictThread = new Thread("evict-block") {
283      @Override
284      public void run() {
285        cache.evictBlock(cacheKey);
286      }
287    };
288    evictThread.start();
289    cache.offsetLock.waitForWaiters(lockId, 1);
290    cache.blockEvicted(cacheKey, cache.backingMap.remove(cacheKey), true, true);
291    assertEquals(0, cache.getBlockCount());
292    cacheAndWaitUntilFlushedToBucket(cache, cacheKey,
293      new CacheTestUtils.ByteArrayCacheable(new byte[10]), true);
294    assertEquals(1, cache.getBlockCount());
295    lock.writeLock().unlock();
296    evictThread.join();
297    /**
298     * <pre>
299     * The asserts here before HBASE-21957 are:
300     * assertEquals(1L, cache.getBlockCount());
301     * assertTrue(cache.getCurrentSize() > 0L);
302     * assertTrue("We should have a block!", cache.iterator().hasNext());
303     *
304     * The asserts here after HBASE-21957 are:
305     * assertEquals(0, cache.getBlockCount());
306     * assertEquals(cache.getCurrentSize(), 0L);
307     *
308     * I think the asserts before HBASE-21957 is more reasonable,because
309     * {@link BucketCache#evictBlock} should only evict the {@link BucketEntry}
310     * it had seen, and newly added Block after the {@link BucketEntry}
311     * it had seen should not be evicted.
312     * </pre>
313     */
314    assertEquals(1L, cache.getBlockCount());
315    assertTrue(cache.getCurrentSize() > 0L);
316    assertTrue("We should have a block!", cache.iterator().hasNext());
317  }

368  private void testRetrievalUtils(Path testDir, String ioEngineName)
369    throws IOException, InterruptedException {
370    final String persistencePath =
371      testDir + "/bucket.persistence" + EnvironmentEdgeManager.currentTime();
372    BucketCache bucketCache = null;
373    try {
374      bucketCache = new BucketCache(ioEngineName, capacitySize, constructedBlockSize,
375        constructedBlockSizes, writeThreads, writerQLen, persistencePath);
376      assertTrue(bucketCache.waitForCacheInitialization(10000));
377      long usedSize = bucketCache.getAllocator().getUsedSize();
378      assertEquals(0, usedSize);
379      HFileBlockPair[] blocks = CacheTestUtils.generateHFileBlocks(constructedBlockSize, 1);
380      for (HFileBlockPair block : blocks) {
381        bucketCache.cacheBlock(block.getBlockName(), block.getBlock());
382      }
383      for (HFileBlockPair block : blocks) {
384        cacheAndWaitUntilFlushedToBucket(bucketCache, block.getBlockName(), block.getBlock(),
385          false);
386      }
387      usedSize = bucketCache.getAllocator().getUsedSize();
388      assertNotEquals(0, usedSize);
389      bucketCache.shutdown();
390      assertTrue(new File(persistencePath).exists());
391      bucketCache = new BucketCache(ioEngineName, capacitySize, constructedBlockSize,
392        constructedBlockSizes, writeThreads, writerQLen, persistencePath);
393      assertTrue(bucketCache.waitForCacheInitialization(10000));
394
395      assertEquals(usedSize, bucketCache.getAllocator().getUsedSize());
396    } finally {
397      if (bucketCache != null) {
398        bucketCache.shutdown();
399      }
400    }
401    assertTrue(new File(persistencePath).exists());
402  }

555  @Test
556  public void testInvalidMinFactorConfig() throws IOException {
557    float[] configValues = { -1f, 0f, 0.96f, 1.05f };
558    // throws due to <0, in expected range, minFactor > acceptableFactor, > 1.0
559    boolean[] expectedOutcomes = { false, true, false, false };

592  private void checkConfigValues(Configuration conf, Map<String, float[]> configMap,
593    boolean[] expectSuccess) throws IOException {
594    Set<String> configNames = configMap.keySet();
595    for (int i = 0; i < expectSuccess.length; i++) {
596      try {
597        for (String configName : configNames) {
598          conf.setFloat(configName, configMap.get(configName)[i]);
599        }
600        BucketCache cache = new BucketCache(ioEngineName, capacitySize, constructedBlockSize,
601          constructedBlockSizes, writeThreads, writerQLen, null, 100, conf);
602        assertTrue(cache.waitForCacheInitialization(10000));
603        assertTrue("Created BucketCache and expected it to succeed: " + expectSuccess[i]
604          + ", but it actually was: " + !expectSuccess[i], expectSuccess[i]);
605      } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
606        assertFalse("Created BucketCache and expected it to succeed: " + expectSuccess[i]
607          + ", but it actually was: " + !expectSuccess[i], expectSuccess[i]);
608      }
609    }
610  }

630  @Test
631  public void testEvictionCount() throws InterruptedException {
632    int size = 100;
633    int length = HConstants.HFILEBLOCK_HEADER_SIZE + size;
634    ByteBuffer buf1 = ByteBuffer.allocate(size), buf2 = ByteBuffer.allocate(size);
635    HFileContext meta = new HFileContextBuilder().build();
636    ByteBuffAllocator allocator = ByteBuffAllocator.HEAP;
637    HFileBlock blockWithNextBlockMetadata = new HFileBlock(BlockType.DATA, size, size, -1,
638      ByteBuff.wrap(buf1), HFileBlock.FILL_HEADER, -1, 52, -1, meta, allocator);
639    HFileBlock blockWithoutNextBlockMetadata = new HFileBlock(BlockType.DATA, size, size, -1,
640      ByteBuff.wrap(buf2), HFileBlock.FILL_HEADER, -1, -1, -1, meta, allocator);
641
642    BlockCacheKey key = new BlockCacheKey("testEvictionCount", 0);
643    ByteBuffer actualBuffer = ByteBuffer.allocate(length);
644    ByteBuffer block1Buffer = ByteBuffer.allocate(length);
645    ByteBuffer block2Buffer = ByteBuffer.allocate(length);
646    blockWithNextBlockMetadata.serialize(block1Buffer, true);
647    blockWithoutNextBlockMetadata.serialize(block2Buffer, true);
648
649    // Add blockWithNextBlockMetadata, expect blockWithNextBlockMetadata back.
650    CacheTestUtils.getBlockAndAssertEquals(cache, key, blockWithNextBlockMetadata, actualBuffer,
651      block1Buffer);
652
653    waitUntilFlushedToBucket(cache, key);
654
655    assertEquals(0, cache.getStats().getEvictionCount());
656
657    // evict call should return 1, but then eviction count be 0
658    assertEquals(1, cache.evictBlocksByHfileName("testEvictionCount"));
659    assertEquals(0, cache.getStats().getEvictionCount());
660
661    // add back
662    key = new BlockCacheKey("testEvictionCount", 0);
663    CacheTestUtils.getBlockAndAssertEquals(cache, key, blockWithNextBlockMetadata, actualBuffer,
664      block1Buffer);
665    waitUntilFlushedToBucket(cache, key);
666
667    // should not increment
668    assertTrue(cache.evictBlock(key));
669    assertEquals(0, cache.getStats().getEvictionCount());
670
671    // add back
672    CacheTestUtils.getBlockAndAssertEquals(cache, key, blockWithNextBlockMetadata, actualBuffer,
673      block1Buffer);
674    waitUntilFlushedToBucket(cache, key);
675
676    // should finally increment eviction count
677    cache.freeSpace("testing");
678    assertEquals(1, cache.getStats().getEvictionCount());
679  }

712  @Test
713  public void testCacheBlockNextBlockMetadataMissing() throws Exception {
714    int size = 100;
715    int length = HConstants.HFILEBLOCK_HEADER_SIZE + size;
716    ByteBuffer buf1 = ByteBuffer.allocate(size), buf2 = ByteBuffer.allocate(size);
717    HFileContext meta = new HFileContextBuilder().build();
718    ByteBuffAllocator allocator = ByteBuffAllocator.HEAP;
719    HFileBlock blockWithNextBlockMetadata = new HFileBlock(BlockType.DATA, size, size, -1,
720      ByteBuff.wrap(buf1), HFileBlock.FILL_HEADER, -1, 52, -1, meta, allocator);
721    HFileBlock blockWithoutNextBlockMetadata = new HFileBlock(BlockType.DATA, size, size, -1,
722      ByteBuff.wrap(buf2), HFileBlock.FILL_HEADER, -1, -1, -1, meta, allocator);
723
724    BlockCacheKey key = new BlockCacheKey("testCacheBlockNextBlockMetadataMissing", 0);
725    ByteBuffer actualBuffer = ByteBuffer.allocate(length);
726    ByteBuffer block1Buffer = ByteBuffer.allocate(length);
727    ByteBuffer block2Buffer = ByteBuffer.allocate(length);

729    blockWithoutNextBlockMetadata.serialize(block2Buffer, true);

731    // Add blockWithNextBlockMetadata, expect blockWithNextBlockMetadata back.
732    CacheTestUtils.getBlockAndAssertEquals(cache, key, blockWithNextBlockMetadata, actualBuffer,
733      block1Buffer);

735    waitUntilFlushedToBucket(cache, key);

737    assertEquals(1, cache.backingMap.get(key).refCnt());

760
761    // Add blockWithNextBlockMetadata, expect blockWithNextBlockMetadata to replace.

763      block1Buffer);
764
765    waitUntilFlushedToBucket(cache, key);

770  @Test
771  public void testRAMCache() {
772    int size = 100;
773    int length = HConstants.HFILEBLOCK_HEADER_SIZE + size;
774    byte[] byteArr = new byte[length];
775    ByteBuffer buf = ByteBuffer.wrap(byteArr, 0, size);
776    HFileContext meta = new HFileContextBuilder().build();
777
778    RAMCache cache = new RAMCache();
779    BlockCacheKey key1 = new BlockCacheKey("file-1", 1);
780    BlockCacheKey key2 = new BlockCacheKey("file-2", 2);
781    HFileBlock blk1 = new HFileBlock(BlockType.DATA, size, size, -1, ByteBuff.wrap(buf),
782      HFileBlock.FILL_HEADER, -1, 52, -1, meta, ByteBuffAllocator.HEAP);
783    HFileBlock blk2 = new HFileBlock(BlockType.DATA, size, size, -1, ByteBuff.wrap(buf),
784      HFileBlock.FILL_HEADER, -1, -1, -1, meta, ByteBuffAllocator.HEAP);
785    RAMQueueEntry re1 = new RAMQueueEntry(key1, blk1, 1, false, false, false);
786    RAMQueueEntry re2 = new RAMQueueEntry(key1, blk2, 1, false, false, false);
787
788    assertFalse(cache.containsKey(key1));
789    assertNull(cache.putIfAbsent(key1, re1));
790    assertEquals(2, ((HFileBlock) re1.getData()).getBufferReadOnly().refCnt());
791
792    assertNotNull(cache.putIfAbsent(key1, re2));
793    assertEquals(2, ((HFileBlock) re1.getData()).getBufferReadOnly().refCnt());
794    assertEquals(1, ((HFileBlock) re2.getData()).getBufferReadOnly().refCnt());
795
796    assertNull(cache.putIfAbsent(key2, re2));
797    assertEquals(2, ((HFileBlock) re1.getData()).getBufferReadOnly().refCnt());
798    assertEquals(2, ((HFileBlock) re2.getData()).getBufferReadOnly().refCnt());
799
800    cache.remove(key1);
801    assertEquals(1, ((HFileBlock) re1.getData()).getBufferReadOnly().refCnt());
802    assertEquals(2, ((HFileBlock) re2.getData()).getBufferReadOnly().refCnt());
803
804    cache.clear();
805    assertEquals(1, ((HFileBlock) re1.getData()).getBufferReadOnly().refCnt());
806    assertEquals(1, ((HFileBlock) re2.getData()).getBufferReadOnly().refCnt());
807  }

850  @Test

900  @Test
901  public void testBlockAdditionWaitWhenCache() throws Exception {
902    BucketCache bucketCache = null;
903    try {
904      final Path dataTestDir = createAndGetTestDir();
905
906      String ioEngineName = "file:" + dataTestDir + "/bucketNoRecycler.cache";
907      String persistencePath = dataTestDir + "/bucketNoRecycler.persistence";
908
909      Configuration config = HBASE_TESTING_UTILITY.getConfiguration();
910      config.setLong(QUEUE_ADDITION_WAIT_TIME, 1000);
911
912      bucketCache = new BucketCache(ioEngineName, capacitySize, constructedBlockSize,
913        constructedBlockSizes, 1, 1, persistencePath, DEFAULT_ERROR_TOLERATION_DURATION, config);
914      assertTrue(bucketCache.waitForCacheInitialization(10000));
915      long usedByteSize = bucketCache.getAllocator().getUsedSize();
916      assertEquals(0, usedByteSize);
917
918      HFileBlockPair[] hfileBlockPairs =
919        CacheTestUtils.generateHFileBlocks(constructedBlockSize, 10);
920      String[] names = CacheTestUtils.getHFileNames(hfileBlockPairs);
921      // Add blocks
922      for (HFileBlockPair hfileBlockPair : hfileBlockPairs) {
923        bucketCache.cacheBlock(hfileBlockPair.getBlockName(), hfileBlockPair.getBlock(), false,
924          true);
925      }
926
927      // Max wait for 10 seconds.
928      long timeout = 10000;
929      // Wait for blocks size to match the number of blocks.
930      while (bucketCache.backingMap.size() != 10) {
931        if (timeout <= 0) break;
932        Threads.sleep(100);
933        timeout -= 100;
934      }
935      for (HFileBlockPair hfileBlockPair : hfileBlockPairs) {
936        assertTrue(bucketCache.backingMap.containsKey(hfileBlockPair.getBlockName()));
937      }
938      usedByteSize = bucketCache.getAllocator().getUsedSize();
939      assertNotEquals(0, usedByteSize);
940      // persist cache to file
941      bucketCache.shutdown();
942      assertTrue(new File(persistencePath).exists());
943
944      // restore cache from file
945      bucketCache = new BucketCache(ioEngineName, capacitySize, constructedBlockSize,
946        constructedBlockSizes, writeThreads, writerQLen, persistencePath);
947      assertTrue(bucketCache.waitForCacheInitialization(10000));
948      assertEquals(usedByteSize, bucketCache.getAllocator().getUsedSize());
949      BlockCacheKey[] newKeys = CacheTestUtils.regenerateKeys(hfileBlockPairs, names);
950      for (BlockCacheKey key : newKeys) {
951        bucketCache.evictBlock(key);
952      }
953      assertEquals(0, bucketCache.getAllocator().getUsedSize());
954      assertEquals(0, bucketCache.backingMap.size());
955    } finally {
956      if (bucketCache != null) {
957        bucketCache.shutdown();
958      }
959      HBASE_TESTING_UTILITY.cleanupTestDir();
960    }
961  }

1083    HFileBlockPair[] hfileBlockPairs =
1084      CacheTestUtils.generateBlocksForPath(constructedBlockSize, 10, filePath, encoded);
1085    // Add blocks
1086    for (HFileBlockPair hfileBlockPair : hfileBlockPairs) {
1087      bucketCache.cacheBlock(hfileBlockPair.getBlockName(), hfileBlockPair.getBlock(), false, true);
1088    }
1089    bucketCache.notifyFileCachingCompleted(filePath, totalBlocksToCheck, totalBlocksToCheck,
1090      totalBlocksToCheck * constructedBlockSize);
1091    return bucketCache;
1092  }

1110  private BucketCache testEvictOrphans(long orphanEvictionGracePeriod) throws Exception {
1111    Path validFile = new Path(HBASE_TESTING_UTILITY.getDataTestDir(), "testEvictOrphans-valid");
1112    Path orphanFile = new Path(HBASE_TESTING_UTILITY.getDataTestDir(), "testEvictOrphans-orphan");
1113    Map<String, HRegion> onlineRegions = new HashMap<>();
1114    List<HStore> stores = new ArrayList<>();
1115    Collection<HStoreFile> storeFiles = new ArrayList<>();
1116    HRegion mockedRegion = mock(HRegion.class);
1117    HStore mockedStore = mock(HStore.class);
1118    HStoreFile mockedStoreFile = mock(HStoreFile.class);
1119    when(mockedStoreFile.getPath()).thenReturn(validFile);
1120    storeFiles.add(mockedStoreFile);
1121    when(mockedStore.getStorefiles()).thenReturn(storeFiles);
1122    stores.add(mockedStore);
1123    when(mockedRegion.getStores()).thenReturn(stores);
1124    onlineRegions.put("mocked_region", mockedRegion);
1125    HBASE_TESTING_UTILITY.getConfiguration().setDouble(MIN_FACTOR_CONFIG_NAME, 0.99);
1126    HBASE_TESTING_UTILITY.getConfiguration().setDouble(ACCEPT_FACTOR_CONFIG_NAME, 1);
1127    HBASE_TESTING_UTILITY.getConfiguration().setDouble(EXTRA_FREE_FACTOR_CONFIG_NAME, 0.01);
1128    HBASE_TESTING_UTILITY.getConfiguration().setLong(BLOCK_ORPHAN_GRACE_PERIOD,
1129      orphanEvictionGracePeriod);
1130    BucketCache bucketCache = new BucketCache(ioEngineName, (constructedBlockSize + 1024) * 21,
1131      constructedBlockSize, new int[] { constructedBlockSize + 1024 }, 1, 1, null, 60 * 1000,
1132      HBASE_TESTING_UTILITY.getConfiguration(), onlineRegions);
1133    HFileBlockPair[] validBlockPairs =
1134      CacheTestUtils.generateBlocksForPath(constructedBlockSize, 10, validFile, false);
1135    HFileBlockPair[] orphanBlockPairs =
1136      CacheTestUtils.generateBlocksForPath(constructedBlockSize, 10, orphanFile, false);
1137    for (HFileBlockPair pair : validBlockPairs) {
1138      bucketCache.cacheBlockWithWait(pair.getBlockName(), pair.getBlock(), false, true);
1139    }
1140    waitUntilAllFlushedToBucket(bucketCache);
1141    assertEquals(10, bucketCache.getBackingMap().size());
1142    bucketCache.freeSpace("test");
1143    assertEquals(10, bucketCache.getBackingMap().size());
1144    for (HFileBlockPair pair : orphanBlockPairs) {
1145      bucketCache.cacheBlockWithWait(pair.getBlockName(), pair.getBlock(), false, true);
1146    }
1147    waitUntilAllFlushedToBucket(bucketCache);
1148    assertEquals(20, bucketCache.getBackingMap().size());
1149    bucketCache.freeSpace("test");
1150    return bucketCache;
1151  }
